scope: Pilot: one training seed (2026) per TimeGAN mode, with three generation seeds. No retraining SD or final-test result.

plan.hypothesis: Static starting-book gaps may reduce incompatible cumulative price paths without suppressing noise diversity.
plan.context: 19 log relative price gaps, standardised using complete training-window anchors only; supplied to all five networks.
plan.architecture_control: Both models have identical parameter counts, initial weights, minibatch and noise streams; zero mode replaces the 19 context values with zeros.
plan.evaluation: Same 1080 chronological validation windows, anchors, metrics and three noise seeds as before; final test unscored. Different information budget, so historical anchor-only scores are supplementary.
plan.decision: Pilot only. Consider independent paired seed repeats if matched context reduces invalidity by at least 5 percentage points while return/spread KL and ACF error increase no more than 5%, depth SSIM falls no more than 0.01, and noise diversity remains. Screen all criteria together, including fixed-final checkpoints; do not claim significance or select a lucky seed.
plan.diversity: Measure noise variation within each of three fixed contexts, separately for price and volume, against real validation feature variability. Between-context variability alone is insufficient.
plan.estimate_basis: Prior two-worker 5000/stage fits took about 64-69 minutes; new networks have 61361 versus 54521 parameters. Estimate includes allowance, not a guarantee.

diagnostics.scope: Observed-input reconstruction and anchor controls, not noise-only generation scores.
Observed-input reconstruction and anchor controls, not noise-only generation scores.

pilot_screen.Criterion: Invalidity gain at least 5 percentage points
Fixed-context noise SD ratios at least 0.1 in every case

conclusion: Matched context gives 41.66% invalid snapshots versus 51.00% for the same-size zero-context control (gain 9.33 percentage points). Return KL is 0.607 versus 0.647; ACF error 0.306 versus 0.176; depth SSIM 0.145 versus 0.128. This is a single training-seed pilot, not confirmation across retraining seeds.
next_step: Pilot screen not met: retain the negative/trade-off evidence; do not expand this configuration into a blind grid or call it a validated simulator.

performance_check.scope: One CPU worker/thread, same first 128 training windows, 3 warm-up and 20 timed joint cycles, temporary discarded models. No validation quality selection; system activity can affect timings.
